body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a 2-unit Circle centered on a point within 4 units. Choose two willing creatures in the Circle; until your next turn, the first time one gains +1 Defense or Rallied, the other gains the same benefit.

surges.html: Increase this Rite's Echo Limit by 1.
Choose one creature or object affected by this Action as the Rite's sympathetic link. The Rite may trigger from that link within 6 units as though it were at the Rite's location.

rider.title: CIRCLE RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: An enemy enters or begins its turn inside the Circle. Echo: It suffers -1 Defense until it leaves the Circle or its turn ends.
